title: Purchase Order Template
description: Free purchase order format for India with PO number, vendor GSTIN, ship-to address, HSN codes, CGST/SGST, delivery date and terms. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Vendor, bill-to and ship-to blocks with GSTIN
Itemised table with HSN, unit, rate and CGST/SGST split
Delivery, payment and inspection terms with authorised signatory
research: All references show a PO number and date, buyer and vendor details with GSTIN, separate ship-to address, line items with HSN, quantity, rate and tax, a required delivery date, payment and freight terms, and an authorised signature.

rows: [Hex bolt with nut, M12 x 50, Gr. 8.8]

blocks.text: Amount in words: **[Rupees One Lakh Fifty-Two Thousand Eight Hundred Ten Only]**

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **PO number:** quote this PO number on your tax invoice, delivery challan and every packing list.
2. **Delivery:** deliver to the ship-to address by the date above, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.
3. **Quality:** material must carry mill test certificates. Rejected items will be returned at your cost.
4. **Payment:** within [30 days] of receipt of material and a correct GST invoice, by NEFT.
5. **Changes:** prices are fixed for this order. Short or late supply may lead to cancellation of the balance.

items: For [Patel Engineering Works Pvt. Ltd.] (Authorised Signatory)
